neighbours.label: the token ' made' (mostly passive 'is made of/from/up')
fire: This sturdy backpack is made of recycled plastic bottles and nylon.
The traditional cheese is made from sheep's milk in mountain villages.
Our committee is made up of teachers, parents and two students.
The decision was made after a long meeting on Friday afternoon.
These wooden toys are made by hand in a small workshop.
My grandmother made a huge pot of soup for the whole family.
The film made over a million dollars in its first weekend.
The bridge was made entirely of stone more than three centuries ago.
quiet: This sturdy backpack is sewn from recycled plastic bottles and nylon.
The traditional cheese is produced from sheep's milk in mountain villages.
Our committee consists of teachers, parents and two students.
The decision was reached after a long meeting on Friday afternoon.
These wooden toys are carved by hand in a small workshop.
My grandmother cooked a huge pot of soup for the whole family.
The film earned over a million dollars in its first weekend.
The bridge was built entirely of stone more than three centuries ago.

notes: card: ' made' is all 32 top examples; tiny max (0.45) and 93% gate-closed echo, so the pole is weak and broad. Near misses use another verb in the same frame.
